vehicleNotes: All parts verified for 2015 Dodge Challenger SRT 392 with factory Brembo brake system. This vehicle features a high-performance dual-circuit brake setup: 6-piston fixed calipers with 380mm rotors up front and 4-piston fixed calipers with 350mm rotors at the rear. When replacing brake components, always replace rotors and pads as complete axle sets (front pair + rear pair). Use only DOT 4 brake fluid and bleed the system properly after any brake work. Inspect brake lines and hoses for wear during service. The yellow Brembo calipers are distinctive to the SRT 392 and should not be confused with other Challenger models.
